n3f6440562c0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AWACS and the Netra AEW&C system?
o: AWACS is mounted on a smaller jet than Netra
Netra is mounted on a smaller jet than AWACS
Netra provides early warning and command-and-control
AWACS has a longer range than Netra
n3f6440562c0.x: Netra is the smaller jet; AWACS is larger, with longer range and full air-battle control.

n6799fc781e4.s:
Consider the following statements about indigenous radars:
1. Swordfish is the long-range tracking radar of the BMD shield.
2. Rajendra is the fire-control radar of the Akash SAM system.
3. Surya is the fire-control radar of the Akash SAM system.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n6799fc781e4.x: Swordfish tracks for the BMD shield and Rajendra is Akash's fire-control radar; Surya is the VHF radar for tracking stealth aircraft.

n1284f948917.s:
Consider the following statements about anti-drone and loitering systems:
1. Indrajaal is an AI-powered anti-drone grid by a Hyderabad start-up.
2. Vayu Astra fires 64 micro-rockets at drone swarms.
3. D4 is a DRDO system with radar, jamming and laser kill.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n1284f948917.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Vayu Astra is NIBE Ltd's loitering munition; it is Bhargavastra that fires 64 micro-rockets.

n30bb4070304.s:
Consider the following statements about CL-20:
1. It is associated with HEMRL, Pune.
2. It is described as the most powerful non-nuclear explosive.
3. It is associated with TBRL, Chandigarh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n30bb4070304.x: CL-20 is associated with the High Energy Materials Research Laboratory (HEMRL), Pune, and is the most powerful non-nuclear explosive; it is not a TBRL product.

nphysics-20-38.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Doppler effect in astronomy?
o: The Doppler effect is used to study the motion of stars
A red shift of starlight shows that the star is approaching
A blue shift of starlight shows that the star is approaching
Red shift and blue shift of starlight are Doppler shifts
nphysics-20-38.x: A red shift means the star is moving away; a blue shift means it is approaching.

nphysics-19-13.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Doppler effect?
o: It is an apparent change in frequency caused by relative motion
An approaching source shows a higher apparent frequency
An approaching sound source sounds lower in pitch
It explains the changing pitch of a passing siren
nphysics-19-13.x: An approaching source sounds higher in pitch, not lower; the Doppler effect is a frequency change from relative motion.

n52633b69b4a.s: The Strategic Partnership (SP) model, in which Indian private firms team up with foreign OEMs, was added in:
n52633b69b4a.x: The SP model came in 2017; DPP 2016 had added the Buy (Indian-IDDM) category.

n3511e9095d5.s: How many Positive Indigenisation Lists, barring imports of listed items after set dates, have been issued?
n3511e9095d5.x: Five Positive Indigenisation Lists have been issued; the SRIJAN portal supports indigenisation.

nbd1d503ed8d.s: Despite record defence exports, which of the following does India still import?
nbd1d503ed8d.x: India remains outside the top 25 arms exporters and still imports jet engines and defence chips; BrahMos and Astra are exported.

n87bf25e18da.s: RAKSHA (Sep 2026), the Defence Minister's roadmap for global defence partnerships, covers a period of:
n87bf25e18da.x: RAKSHA is a 10-year roadmap; its pillars include indigenous exports and maritime security.

n036ed6679f9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's defence indigenisation?
o: India depends on imported engines and semiconductors
A small share of defence expenditure goes to R&D
Foreign direct investment in defence has been low
India is among the top 25 arms exporters
n036ed6679f9.x: India remains outside the top 25 arms exporters; import dependence, a small R&D share and low FDI are its challenges.

n2785268819f.s: With reference to NITI Aayog's 'Scenarios Towards Viksit Bharat and Net Zero', which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Renewables' share of generation by 2070 – about 80%
Renewables' share of generation in 2024-25 – about 50%
Coal's share of generation in 2024-25 – about 20%
Coal's share of generation by 2070 – about 80%
n2785268819f.x: Renewables rise from about 20% (2024-25) to about 80% by 2070, while coal falls from about 74% to 6-10%.

n57c6ab7862b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's electricity shortage?
n57c6ab7862b.x: The shortage was 4.2% in FY14; it fell to 0.03% in 2025 and to zero by November 2025.

new.s: Jala Usha (1948), the first Indian-built ship, was built by:
new.x: Jala Usha, the first Indian-built ship (1948), came from Hindustan Shipyard, Visakhapatnam.

new.s: Which destroyer is the fourth and last of Project 15B?
new.x: Surat (2025) is the 4th and last P15B Visakhapatnam-class destroyer.

new.s: INS Tamal, commissioned on 1 July 2025, was built at:
new.x: INS Tamal was built abroad at the Yantar Shipyard, Kaliningrad, Russia.

new.s: With INS Arihant, India became the ____ country with armed nuclear submarine (SSBN) capability.
new.x: INS Arihant, inducted in August 2016, made India the 6th country with this capability.

new.s: In the Indian Air Force, the IL-76 is a:
new.x: The Russian IL-76 is a heavy transport, not a combat aircraft; the IL-78 is the refuelling tanker.

new.s: How many Rafale-M aircraft have been ordered for the Indian Navy?
new.x: 26 Rafale-M have been ordered for the Navy; the IAF has 36 Rafales.

new.s: The LCH Prachand, a light combat helicopter for high altitude, was developed by:
new.x: LCH Prachand is a HAL light combat helicopter for high-altitude operations.

new.s: The HTT-40, developed by HAL, is a:
new.x: HTT-40 is HAL's basic turboprop trainer.

new.s: The Boeing C-17 Globemaster III in IAF service is a:
new.x: The C-17 Globemaster III from Boeing, USA, is a strategic heavy-lift aircraft.

new.s: Lakshya, developed by DRDO-ADE, is a:
new.x: Lakshya is a pilotless target drone of DRDO-ADE.

new.s: Ghatak, with a flying-wing design, is India's:
new.x: Ghatak is a stealth flying-wing unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV).

new.s: The Tejas Mk-1A carries which indigenous AESA radar?
new.x: Tejas Mk-1A has the Uttam AESA radar, an EW suite and air-to-air refuelling.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Tejas Light Combat Aircraft:
1. It is a 4.5-generation light multirole supersonic fighter.
2. It has a compound delta-wing, tailless design.
3. It is a twin-engine fighter.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Tejas is a 4.5-generation, tailless compound delta-wing fighter, but it has a single engine.

new.s: The Tejas fighter was named by:
new.x: Tejas was named by Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

new.s: Dhanush, the Bofors-based 155 mm gun, is made by:
new.x: Dhanush is Bofors-based and made by OFB Jabalpur; ATAGS is the DRDO-ARDE gun.

new.s: Akashteer, an air-defence control network, was developed by:
new.x: Akashteer is an air-defence control network by BEL with the Army.

new.s: The Arjun Mk-1A main battle tank was developed by DRDO's:
new.x: Arjun Mk-1A, a third-generation MBT, is from DRDO's CVRDE, Chennai.

new.s: The Pinaka LRGR-120, first test-fired at ITR Chandipur on 29 Dec 2025, has a range of:
new.x: Pinaka LRGR-120 had its maiden test on 29 Dec 2025 with a range of 120 km.

new.s: The T-90 Bhishma tank of Russian origin is licence-built at:
new.x: The T-90 Bhishma is licence-built at Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi.

new.s: Project 17A comprises:
new.x: P17A builds Nilgiri-class frigates, not destroyers; P15B is the destroyer project.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: P28 is the Kamorta-class corvette project; P15B = destroyers, P17A = frigates, P75 = submarines.

new.s: How many stealth frigates are being built under Project 17A?
new.x: Project 17A has seven Nilgiri-class stealth frigates, built by MDL and GRSE.

new.s: INS Sindhurakshak, which sank after a fire at the Mumbai dockyard on 14 Aug 2013, was a:
new.x: INS Sindhurakshak was a Russian Kilo-class submarine.

new.s: Which P17A frigate, the seventh of the class, joined the Eastern Fleet on 18 July 2026?
new.x: Mahendragiri, the 7th P17A frigate, joined the Eastern Fleet on 18 July 2026.

new.s: USHUS is an indigenous:
new.x: USHUS is an integrated submarine sonar; Maareech is the anti-torpedo decoy.

new.s: TAL, launched from helicopters such as the MH-60R and from the P-8I, is a:
new.x: TAL is a lightweight torpedo; Varunastra is the heavyweight one.

new.s: The Air Independent Propulsion (AIP) system lets a diesel-electric submarine:
o: Run on a pressurised light-water reactor
new.x: AIP, a DRDO-NMRL fuel-cell system, keeps a diesel-electric submarine submerged longer without snorkelling.

new.s: INS Astradharini, India's first indigenous torpedo launch and recovery vessel, was commissioned in 2015 at:
new.x: INS Astradharini was commissioned on 6 Oct 2015 at Visakhapatnam.

new.s: Hindustan Shipyard, Visakhapatnam, was founded in 1941 by:
new.x: Hindustan Shipyard was founded in 1941 by Scindia Steam Navigation; it is now an MoD PSU.

new.s: GRSE, a Defence PSU that has built 118 warships, is located at:
new.x: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) is at Kolkata.

new.s: How many radar stations form the Indian Coast Guard's coastal radar chain set up after 26/11?
new.x: The Coast Guard has 84 radar stations in the coastal radar chain set up after 26/11.

new.s: How many Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessels are being built for the Coast Guard?
new.x: Goa Shipyard is building eight Adamya-class FPVs.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Indian Coast Guard?
o: Search and rescue is one of its roles
Its Adamya-class FPVs are built by GRSE
new.x: The Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessels are built by Goa Shipyard, not GRSE.

new.s: INS Dega at Visakhapatnam is a:
new.x: INS Dega is the naval air station at Visakhapatnam; the new submarine base is at Rambilli.

new.s: The Naval Commanders' Conference is held:
new.x: The Naval Commanders' Conference is held twice a year; the first 2024 edition began on 5 March 2024.

new.s: Which type of radar produces images at night and through clouds?
new.x: SAR images at night and through clouds.

new.s: Over-the-horizon radar works by:
o: Bouncing HF waves off the ionosphere
Using long VHF waves to pick up stealth aircraft
Placing a T/R module on every element
Measuring the frequency shift of echoes
new.x: Over-the-horizon radar bounces HF waves off the ionosphere.

new.s: In an AESA radar, the beam is steered:
o: By bouncing HF waves off the ionosphere
new.x: AESA has a T/R module on every element and steers its beam electronically; examples are UTTAM and MF-STAR.

new.s: Arudhra is an IAF:
new.x: Arudhra is an IAF medium-power 4D, 360° surveillance radar of 300+ km.

new.s: The Swathi weapon-locating radar, made by BEL, has been exported to:
new.x: BEL's Swathi weapon-locating radar has been exported to Armenia.

new.s: Which indigenous radar tracks stealth aircraft?
new.x: Surya is the VHF radar for tracking stealth aircraft.

new.s: INDRA (Indian Doppler Radar) is used for:
new.x: INDRA is a low-level surveillance radar.

new.s: The D4 anti-drone system, with radar, jamming and laser kill, was developed by:
new.x: D4 is DRDO's anti-drone system; it detects at 4 km and kills within 1 km.

new.s: Samyukta is the Army's:
new.x: Samyukta is the Army's mobile integrated ground electronic warfare system.

new.s: Himshakti, an electronic warfare system for mountain terrain, was developed by:
new.x: Himshakti is a mountain-terrain EW system from DLRL Hyderabad.

new.s: Akash Tarang, approved by the DAC in July 2026, is an anti-drone:
o: EW soft-kill system that jams control signals
new.x: Akash Tarang is an anti-drone EW soft-kill system that jams control signals.

new.s: Carbon-carbon and C-SiC composites for heat shields and nozzles are associated with:
new.x: Carbon-carbon / C-SiC composites come from ASL Hyderabad.

new.s: Maraging steel is used mainly in:
new.x: Maraging steel is used in rocket casings and submarine hulls.

new.s: HMX is also known as:
new.x: HMX is Octogen (High Melting Explosive); Cyclonite and Hexogen are RDX, HNIW is CL-20.

new.s: Dynamite consists of nitroglycerine absorbed in:
new.x: Dynamite is nitroglycerine in kieselguhr or sawdust.

new.s: 2-DG, the anti-COVID oral drug, was developed by INMAS with:
new.x: 2-DG was developed by INMAS with Dr Reddy's; DCGI gave emergency use in May 2021.

new.s: OxyCare, an SpO2-based oxygen supply system, was developed by:
new.x: OxyCare comes from DEBEL.

new.s: DIHAR, Leh, works mainly on:
new.x: DIHAR does high-altitude agriculture and herbal products; DIPAS covers high-altitude physiology.

new.s: Which of the following is one of the 7 DPSUs formed from the Ordnance Factory Board in 2021?
new.x: The 41 OFB factories became 7 DPSUs, including Gliders India and Troop Comforts.

new.s: The Buy (Indian-IDDM) category was first added in:
new.x: DPP 2016 (Dhirendra Singh committee) first added Buy (Indian-IDDM); 2017 brought the SP model.

new.s: iDEX was launched by the Prime Minister in:
new.x: iDEX (Innovations for Defence Excellence) was launched in April 2018.

new.s: How many buy categories are there under DAP 2020?
new.x: DAP 2020 has five buy categories, from Buy (Indian-IDDM) down to Buy (Global).

new.s: Which DAP 2020 procurement category has the LOWEST priority?
new.x: Buy (Global) is the lowest of the five categories.

new.s: Under DAP 2020, Buy (Global – Manufacture in India) replaced the older category of:
new.x: Buy (Global – Manufacture in India) replaced the old Buy and Make category.

new.s: SRIJAN is a/an:
o: Start-up challenge set by the Services
new.x: SRIJAN is the indigenisation portal where DPSUs and Services list import items Indian industry can make.

new.s: iDEX stands for:
new.x: iDEX is Innovations for Defence Excellence.

new.s: The Technology Development Fund gives grants of up to how much per project?
new.x: TDF, executed by DRDO, gives up to ₹50 crore per project.

new.s: The TDF-funded green propulsion system proved in orbit on PSLV-C58 was developed by:
new.x: Bengaluru start-up Bellatrix Aerospace built the 1N green monopropellant thruster, proved on PSLV-C58 (POEM).

new.s: Agnishodh, the Indian Army Research Cell inaugurated on 4 Aug 2025, is at:
new.x: Agnishodh is the Indian Army Research Cell at the IIT Madras Research Park.

new.s: Agnishodh, the Army research cell at IIT Madras, was inaugurated by:
new.x: Army Chief Gen. Upendra Dwivedi inaugurated Agnishodh on 4 Aug 2025.

new.s: GTRE is developing the marine gas turbine 'Samudra' from which engine?
new.x: GTRE's marine gas turbine 'Samudra' is derived from the Kaveri engine.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT made in India?
new.x: The Akula submarine was leased from Russia; Su-30 MKI and T-90 are licence-built in India and ATAGS is indigenous.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Make in India defence platforms:
1. Su-30 MKI is a licence-built Russian design.
2. ATAGS is an indigenous DRDO-ARDE towed gun.
3. Arjun is a licence-built Russian tank.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Su-30 MKI is licence-built at HAL Nashik and ATAGS is indigenous; Arjun is an indigenous DRDO-CVRDE tank.

new.s: The Dhruv Advanced Light Helicopter is made by:
new.x: Dhruv ALH, like HTT-40, is made by HAL.

new.s: Khanderi and Vagir belong to:
new.x: Khanderi and Vagir are Project 75 Kalvari-class Scorpenes built by MDL.

new.s: India's first indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant (IAC-1) was built at:
new.x: INS Vikrant (IAC-1) was built at Cochin Shipyard.

new.s: The stealth frigate Tavasya was built at:
new.x: Tavasya is a stealth frigate from Goa Shipyard.

new.s: Which of the following is a node of the Tamil Nadu Defence Industrial Corridor?
new.x: Tamil Nadu's nodes are Chennai, Coimbatore, Hosur, Salem and Tiruchirappalli.

new.s: How many nodes does the Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridor have?
new.x: The UP corridor has six nodes: Agra, Aligarh, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Kanpur and Lucknow; Tamil Nadu has five.

new.s: The BrahMos unit of the Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridor is at:
new.x: The BrahMos unit is at Lucknow in the UP corridor.

new.s: The nodal agency of the Tamil Nadu Defence Industrial Corridor is:
new.x: TIDCO is the nodal agency for Tamil Nadu; UPEIDA for Uttar Pradesh.

new.s: BEL's unit at Machilipatnam, Andhra Pradesh, specialises in:
o: Refit of Eastern Naval Command ships
new.x: BEL Machilipatnam makes opto-electronics / night vision; BEL Palasamudram integrates missiles and radars.

new.s: The BEL Palasamudram complex for missile and radar systems integration is in which district?
new.x: BEL Palasamudram is in Sri Sathya Sai district.

new.s: Rambilli in Anakapalli district is the site of a new:
new.x: Rambilli is the new ENC submarine base, including for nuclear boats.

new.s: FDI in defence beyond 74% and up to 100% is allowed through the:
new.x: 74% is automatic; above 74% up to 100% needs the government route.

new.s: The defence export target for 2025 under DPEPP 2020 was:
new.x: DPEPP 2020 set ₹35,000 crore exports (not ₹50,000 crore) and ₹1.75 lakh crore production.

new.s: India's record defence production in FY 2025-26 was:
new.x: Actual FY 2025-26 production was ₹1.78 lakh crore; ₹1.75 lakh crore was the DPEPP target.

new.s: The Philippines is a buyer of which Indian missile?
new.x: The Philippines bought BrahMos; Indonesia is linked to Astra.

new.s: India's defence exports rose from ₹686 crore in 2013-14 to how much in 2024-25?
new.x: Exports grew about 34-fold to ₹23,622 crore in 2024-25.

new.s: Samudra Laksamana is a naval exercise between India and:
new.x: Samudra Laksamana is the India–Malaysia naval exercise.

new.s: The 3rd edition of Samudra Laksamana (28 Feb – 2 Mar 2024) was held off:
new.x: It was held off Visakhapatnam with INS Kiltan and KD Lekir.

new.s: The first DefExpo was held in:
new.x: DefExpo, a biennial expo, was first held in 1999.

new.s: DefExpo 2022 at Gandhinagar was which edition of the expo?
new.x: DefExpo 2022 (18–22 Oct, Gandhinagar, 'Path to Pride') was the 12th edition.

new.s: As per NITI Aayog's IESS, India's electricity demand between 2012 and 2040 would rise about:
new.x: IESS projects electricity demand to rise 4.5-fold; total energy demand 2.7–3.2 times.

new.s: The Electric Power Survey is published by:
new.x: The Electric Power Survey and NGAP are CEA reports.

new.s: According to the IEA's World Energy Outlook 2022, India's coal generation and oil imports peak around:
new.x: WEO 2022 sees India's coal generation and oil imports peaking around 2030.

new.s: By 2037-38, the India Cooling Action Plan aims to cut cooling demand by:
new.x: ICAP targets a 20–25% cut in cooling demand and 25–30% in refrigerant demand.

new.s: Which source ranks second in India's energy supply after fossil fuels?
new.x: After fossil fuels, solar is the second source (UPPSC 2021).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about India's energy demand:
1. India is the third-largest energy consumer in the world.
2. India's energy demand is projected to triple by 2047.
3. India is the largest coal consumer in the world.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: India is the third-largest energy consumer and its demand is to triple by 2047; it is the second-largest coal consumer.

new.s: India's per-capita electricity consumption is about ____ of the USA's.
new.x: It is about 1/5 of China's and 1/9 of the USA's.

new.s: Which energy demand in India is projected to fall by 2040?
new.x: Industry stays the largest consumer; cooking demand falls, while cooling and data centres drive growth.

new.s: About what share of Indian households is electrified?
new.x: Household electrification is about 99%; Saubhagya covered about 26 million households.

new.s: On 25 April 2026, India's electricity deficit was confined to:
new.x: There was no solar-hour shortage; a 2% non-solar deficit made the evening peak the focus of storage.

new.s: India's record peak demand of 270.8 GW in May 2026 was higher than in 2019 by about:
new.x: The 270.8 GW record (May 2026) was about 90 GW above 2019.

new.s: About what share of India's crude oil is imported?
new.x: About 88% of crude oil is imported; gas/LNG import dependence is about 50–51%.

new.s: India's share of the world's coal reserves is about:
new.x: India has about 7% of coal reserves but only 0.4% of oil and 0.6% of gas.

new.s: India's updated NDC (Aug 2022) targets a cut in emissions intensity of GDP versus 2005, by 2030, of:
new.x: The Aug 2022 NDC targets 45% by 2030; 47% is the 2035 target and 36% is already achieved.

new.s: India's NDC for 2031–35 sets a non-fossil share of installed capacity of:
new.x: The 2031–35 NDC raises the non-fossil capacity target to 60% (the 2022 NDC had 50%).

new.s: The Draft National Electricity Policy 2026 targets how much pumped storage by 2047?
new.x: The draft policy, replacing the 2005 policy, targets 100 GW of pumped storage by 2047.

new.s: CEA's Resource Adequacy Plan projects Andhra Pradesh's peak demand by 2035-36 at:
new.x: AP's peak is projected at 30,927 MW by 2035-36, with about 5,588 MW of new thermal capacity.

new.s: How much of Andhra Pradesh's new thermal capacity has APERC cleared first?
new.x: APERC cleared the first 1,600 MW of the planned new thermal capacity.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's September 2026 energy roadmap plans battery storage (BESS) of:
new.x: The roadmap plans 1,500 MW/6,000 MWh BESS; the NHPC VGF project is 500 MW/1,000 MWh.
